mn139:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn139:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn139:2.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn139:3.1: Na kāmasukham anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ;
mn139:3.2: ete te ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā Tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
mn139:3.3: Ussādanañ ca jaññā apasādanañ ca jaññā
mn139:3.4: ussādanañ ca ñatvā apasādanañ ca ñatvā n' ev' ussādeyya na apasādeyya dhammam eva deseyya.
mn139:3.7: Raho vādaṃ na bhāseyya. Sammukhā na khīṇaṃ bhaṇe.
mn139:4.1: Na kāmasukham anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyañjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitan ti
mn139:4.2: iti pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
mn139:4.3: Yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhiṇo somanassānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjaniko anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto sa-upāyāso sapariḷāho micchāpaṭipadā.
mn139:4.4: Yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ ananuyogo hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho sammāpaṭipadā.
mn139:4.5: Yo attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto sa-upāyāso sapariḷāho micchāpaṭipadā.
mn139:4.6: Yo attakilamathānuyogo ananuyogo dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthadukkhaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho sammāpaṭipadā.
mn139:4.7: Na kāmasukham anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na c' attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitan ti
mn139:4.8: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn139:5.1: Ete te ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā Tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatīti
mn139:5.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
mn139:5.3: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn139:5.4: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṃkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammā-ājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
mn139:5.5: Ete te ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā Tathāgatena abhisambuddhā . . . saṃvattatīti
mn139:5.6: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn139:6.1: Ussādanañ ca jaññā apasādanañ ca jaññā
mn139:6.2: ussādanañ ca ñatvā apasādanañ ca ñatvā n' ev' ussādeyya na apasādeyya dhammam eva deseyyāti
mn139:6.3: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
mn139:7.1: Kathañ ca, bhikkhave, ussādanā ca hoti apasādanā ca hoti no ca dhammadesanā?
mn139:7.2: "Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā sa-upaghātā sa-upāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:7.4: "Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:7.6: "Ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuttā dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitam, sabbe te sadukkhā sa-upaghātā sa-upāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:7.8: "Ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ ananuyuttā dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:7.10: "Yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ appahīnaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā sa-upaghātā sa-upāpāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:7.12: "Yesaṃ kesañci vibhavasaṃyojanaṃ pahīnaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:7.14: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ussādanā ca hoti apasādanā ca no ca dhammadesanā.
mn139:8.1: Kathañ ca, bhikkhave, n' ev' ussādanā hoti na apasādanā dhammadesanā ca?
mn139:8.2: "Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā sa-upaghātā sa-upāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:8.4: "Anuyogo ca kho sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:8.7: "Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:8.9: "Ananuyogo ca kho adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:8.12: "Ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuttā dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthāsaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā sa-upaghātā sa-upāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpatipannā ti"
mn139:8.14: "Anuyogo ca kho sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:8.17: "Ye attakilamathānuyogaṃ anuyuttā dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:8.19: "Ananuyogo ca kho adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:8.22: "Yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ appahīmaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā sa-upaghātā sa-upāvāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:8.26: "Yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ pahīnaṃ, sabbe te adukkhā anupaghātā anupāyāsā apariḷāhā sammāpaṭipannā ti"
mn139:8.28: "Bhavasaṃyojane ca kho pahīne bhavo pahīno hotīti"
mn139:8.30: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, n' ev' ussādanā hoti na apasādanā dhammadesanā ca.
mn139:8.31: Ussādanañ ca jaññā apasādanañ ca jaññā
mn139:8.32: ussādanañ ca ñatvā apasādanañ ca ñatvā n' ev' ussādeyya na apasādeyya dhammam eva deseyyāti
mn139:8.33: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn139:9.3: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
mn139:9.6: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
mn139:9.10: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn139:9.12: Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhasomanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ puthujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ.
mn139:9.13: Na āsevitabbaṃ na bhāvetabbaṃ na bahulīkātabbaṃ bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassāti vadāmi.
mn139:9.14: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
mn139:9.15: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ
mn139:9.18: Idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ.
mn139:9.19: Āsevitabbaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ bahulīkātabbaṃ na bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassāti vadāmi.
mn139:9.22: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn139:10.1: Rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya; sammukhā na khīṇaṃ bhaṇe ti
mn139:10.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, yaṃ jaññā rahovādaṃ abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sasakkaṃ taṃ rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya;
mn139:10.5: yam pi jaññā rahovādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, tassa pi sikkheyya avacanāya;
mn139:10.6: yan ca kho jaññā rahovādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ, tatra kālaññū assa tassa rahovādassa vacanāya.
mn139:10.7: Tatra, bhikkhave, yaṃ jaññā sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, sasakkaṃ taṃ sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ na bhāseyya;
mn139:10.8: yam pi jaññā sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, tassa pi sikkheyya avacanāya;
mn139:10.9: yañ ca kho jaññā sammukhā khīṇavādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ, tatra kālaññū assa tassa sammukhā khīṇavādassa vacanāya.
mn139:10.10: Rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya; sammukhā na khīṇaṃ bhaṇe ti
mn139:10.11: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn139:11.1: Ataramāno va bhāseyya no taramāno ti
mn139:11.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
mn139:11.3: Tatra, bhikkhave, taramānassa bhāsato kāyo pi kilamati cittam pi upahaññati saro pi upahaññati kaṇṭho pi āturīyati, avissaṭṭham pi hoti aviññeyyaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ.
mn139:11.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, ataramānassa bhāsato kāyo pi na kilamati cittam pi na upahaññati saro pi na upahaññati kaṇṭho pi na āturīyati, vissaṭṭham pi hoti viññeyyaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ.
mn139:11.5: Ataramāno va bhāseyya na taramāno ti
mn139:11.6: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn139:12.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
mn139:12.3: Kathañ ca, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca abhiniveso hoti samaññāya ca atisāro?
mn139:12.4: Idha, bhikkhave, tad ev' ekaccesu janapadesu Pātīti sañjānanti, Pattan ti sañjānanti, Vitthan ti sañjānanti, Sarāvan ti sañjānanti, Dhāropan ti sañjānanti, Poṇan ti sañjānanti, Pisīlan ti sañjānanti.
mn139:12.5: Iti yathā yathā naṃ tesu tesu janapadesu sañjānanti, tathā tathā thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati:
mn139:12.6: Idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti.
mn139:12.7: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca abhiniveso hoti samaññāya ca atisāro.
mn139:12.8: Kathañ ca, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca anabhiniveso hoti samaññāya ca anatisāro?
mn139:12.9: Idha, bhikkhave, tad ev' ekaccesu janapadesu pātī ti sañjānanti, pattan ti sañjānanti, vitthan ti sañjānanti, sarāvan ti sañjānanti, dhāropan ti sañjānanti, poṇan ti sañjānanti, pisīlan ti sañjānanti.
mn139:12.10: Iti yathā yathā naṃ tesu tesu janapadesu sañjānanti: Idaṃ kira 'me āyasmanto sandhāya vohārantīti, tathā tathā voharati aparāmasaṃ.
mn139:12.11: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, janapadaniruttiyā ca anabhiniveso hoti samaññaya ca anatisāro.
mn139:12.13: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn139:13.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogo hīno gammo pothujjano anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto sa-upāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:13.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ ananuyogo hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:13.7: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo attakilamathānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto sa-upāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:13.10: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo attakilamathānuyogaṃ ananuyogo dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:13.13: Tatra, bhikkhave, yā 'yaṃ majjhimā paṭipadā Tathāgatena abhisambuddhā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:13.16: Tatra, bhikkhave, yā 'yaṃ ussādanā ca apasādanā ca no ca dhammadesanā, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto sa-upāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:13.19: Tatra, bhikkhave, yā 'yaṃ n' ev' ussādanā na apasādanā dhammadesanā vā, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:13.22: Tatra, bhikkhave, yam idaṃ kāmasukhaṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ puthujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto sa-upāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:13.25: Tatra, bhikkhave, yam idaṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:13.28: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ rahovādo abhūto ataccho anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:13.31: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo pāyaṃ rahovādo bhūto taccho anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto sa-upāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:13.34: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ rahovādo bhūto taccho atthasaṃhito, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:13.37: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ sammukhā khīṇavādo abhūto ataccho anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto sa-upāyāso sapariḷāho
mn139:13.40: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo pāyaṃ sammukhā khīnavādo bhūto taccho anatthasaṃhito, sadukkho . .
mn139:13.43: Tatra, bhikkhave, yo pāyaṃ sammukhā khīṇavādo bhūto taccho atthasaṃhito, adukkho . . .
mn139:13.46: Tatra, bhikkhave, yam idaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ, sadukkho eso dhammo . . .
mn139:13.49: Tatra, bhikkhave, yam idaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ, adukkho . . .
mn139:13.52: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ janapadaniruttiyā ca abhiniveso samaññāya ca atisāro, sadukkho eso dhammo sa-upaghāto . . .
mn139:13.55: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ janapadaniruttiyā ca anabhiniveso samaññāya ca anatisāro, adukkho eso dhammo anupaghāto anupāyāso apariḷāho
mn139:14.1: Tasmāt iha, bhikkhave, saraṇañ ca dhammaṃ jānissāma araṇañ ca dhammaṃ jānissāma,
mn139:14.2: saraṇañ ca dhammaṃ ñatvā araṇañ ca dhammaṃ ñatvā araṇapaṭipadaṃ paṭipajjissāmāti, -- evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn139:14.3: Subhūti ca pana, bhikkhave, kulaputto araṇapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno ti.
mn139:14.5: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun
